samples.summary: Master de-duplication still keys on raw rel targets, so equivalent forms now resolvable to the same part are not deduped
samples.evidence: packages/slides/src/import/pptx/index.ts:287-296 — `orderedMasterTargets` builds its `seen` set from `rel.target` (raw). After this change `'/ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml'` and `'../slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml'` both resolve (via `resolveRelsTarget` at index.ts:350) to the same archive entry, but the raw-string dedupe would keep both, importing the same master and its layouts twice. Fix belongs at index.ts:287-296 (dedupe on the resolved path).

samples.summary: Sibling OOXML rels-resolution in packages/docs still cannot handle package-root-relative targets; the three implementations have now drifted further
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/import/docx-importer.ts:40-43 `relsDirFor` + the concatenation at :745-747 (and the image path join around :683) always prefix the part directory, so a DOCX rel with `Target="/word/media/image1.png"` resolves to `word//word/media/image1.png` and the image is silently dropped. packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-importer.ts:129-134 already special-cases leading `/`; slides now does too, leaving docs the odd one out (docs/design/shared-core-extraction.md:79 flags this triplication).
